query:
UPDATE task_specs
            SET status = $2,
                approved_by = $3,
                approved_at = $4,
                rejection_reason = $5,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE id = $1
            RETURNING
                id as "id!: Uuid",
                task_id as "task_id!: Uuid",
                overview,
                user_stories,
                scope,
                out_of_scope,
                deliverables,
                status as "status!: TaskSpecStatus",
                approved_by,
                approved_at as "approved_at?: DateTime<Utc>",
                rejection_reason,
                created_at as "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>",
                updated_at as "updated_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
